emails.subject: [CONFIDENTIAL] Quick favor — gift cards for the team this afternoon?

I'm in back-to-back meetings all afternoon and need a quick favor. Can you grab $1,500 in Apple gift cards as a surprise for the engineering team's morale this week? I'll reimburse you tomorrow when I'm back at the office.

Send the card numbers to my personal Gmail (this address) once you have them. Time-sensitive — they're going out tonight.
